title: CORPRES — A Fully Annotated Corpus of Russian Speech
eligibility_basis: Primary non-singing Russian production; 40% manually segmented and fully annotated on six phonetic/prosodic levels
manual_annotation_evidence: Paper states 40% manually segmented and fully annotated; six levels include pitch marks, phonetic events, narrow and wide phonetic transcription, orthographic and prosodic transcription
exclusion_or_review_reason: Do not core-admit until authoritative public machine-readable corpus deposit/access terms and separability of the manual 40% are verified
notes: 4 female + 4 male speakers; 7.5 h per speaker. Remaining 60% only partly annotated; preserve tier-level eligibility if data located.
